title: Understanding the Objective Function
text: The objective function R(θ) $$=$$ $$\frac{1}{3}$$ $${\sum x_i-\theta}^2$$ is a measure of how well θ represents the data points. Think about what value of θ would make the differences $$x_i-\theta$$ as small as possible.

title: Exploring the Mean
text: Consider the mean of the data set {1,6,17}. The mean is often a good starting point for minimizing squared differences. Calculate the mean and see how it relates to the objective function.

title: Minimizing Squared Differences
text: The value of θ that minimizes the sum of squared differences is the mean of the data set. This is because the mean balances the data points around it, minimizing the total squared distance.
